audience.who: compiler engineers who know SSA values and memrefs but have not read this utility or its consumer
audience.goal: understand the accumulate-and-query may-alias pattern, what the class owns and does not do, and how its state evolves

learning_objectives: Explain the union-find may-alias pattern in one sentence
Name the class's five public operations and its single owned state
Trace one alias pair from IR evidence to a merged equivalence class
State the memref-only closure rule and the silent no-op consequence
Point out the testing gap (no dedicated unit test; indirect coverage only)

storyline.claim: 消费方需要传递性 may-alias 关系，但 IR 只给局部证据（cast 的 result↔source），必须有人把证据累积成可查询形态
memref 值上的并查集：seed 每个 memref 为单独等价类，收到别名证据就合并，查询即等价判断
consumer 栈上的 RAII 对象，每次分析一个实例；唯一 owned state 是 aliasInfo；消费方拥有证据循环，类只负责累积与回答
三个真实状态阶段：seed（全单元素类）→ absorb（证据对合并类，实测 subview∪block-arg）→ query（等价判断）；memref-only 守卫让混合类型 union 静默无效
查询域封闭在 seed 过的 memref；不做自己的流/指针分析；无专属单测，行为只被 merge fixtures 间接覆盖
四条 takeaway：并查集模式、消费方拥有证据循环、封闭域守卫、单消费方无单测
